text:
Nina R (Growth): quick brainstorm — run a 15m "mini-launch" livestream to drive starter-credit activation + two tiny prompt packs. tight demo, instant CTA. :zap:
Owen L (Content): nice. headline thought: 'Get started in 10 minutes — credits + prompt kits'. feels friendly and practical.
Sam (Analytics): measurement plan: register -> attend -> first-48h active users. primary KPI = pct of attendees with >=5 calls in 48h. set baseline and 1-week retention as secondary.
Priya D (Design): I can whip up 1 hero slide + two 1-up screenshots for the landing. want light motion for social.
Nina R (Growth): audience = new signups in last 5 days + trial activations. exclude heavy users. split experiment on credit timing: immediate vs post-livestream.
Owen L (Content): I'll draft three short emails: invite, 24h reminder, and a follow-up with prompt pack links. two copy variants for A/B (practical vs inspirational).
Sam (Analytics): routing snippet for ops:
```
route: mini_launch_credits_2026
cohorts: [new_signups_120h, trial_activations_7d]
variants: {immediate_grant, post_event_grant}
metrics: [registrations, attend_rate, 48h_active_pct, 7d_retention]
```
Nina R (Growth): also want to capture intent via one-question poll after signup: "Which pack do you plan to use? Outreach / Ideation / Support"
Priya D (Design): I'll include a small UX flow for email -> landing -> claim credits so the copy aligns.
Owen L (Content): social thread plan: short demo clip + benchmark tease: "See how a 15m demo leads to X activated users" publish same-day. will draft tone options.
Sam (Analytics): targets: attend_rate 15%+, 48h_active_pct 14%+, 7d_retention 7%+. will wire dashboard and experiment toggles.
DeployBot: event created for 2026-06-02 16:00 UTC. Invite: Nina, Owen, Sam, Priya. Meeting link is private.
Nina R (Growth): solid. post-event we should publish a concise benchmarks note (email + short blog) focused on cost-per-activated-user and prompt-pack preference breakdown. Owen, can you reserve a quick quote?
Owen L (Content): yes — will prepare a 1-2 sentence exec quote to slot into the benchmark.
Sam (Analytics): I'll add a column for prompt-pack conversion and include cost estimate per activated user.
Priya D (Design): will hand off assets to Owen after the slide is approved.
Nina R (Growth): thanks all. sync tomorrow 0900 PT for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
